prompt:
You are a professional technical writer specializing in creating concise, accurate summaries. Your task is to summarize the following technical document while preserving all critical information.

## Input Document
{document_text}

## Summary Requirements
- Length: {target_length} words (±10% tolerance)
- Style: Technical but accessible
- Include: Key findings, methodology, results, and recommendations
- Exclude: Repetitive content, tangential details
- Format: Structured sections with clear headings
- Tone: Neutral, objective, professional

## Quality Metrics
- Clarity score (1-10)
- Completeness score (1-10)
- Conciseness score (1-10)

Provide the summary followed by self-assessed quality metrics.
notes: Text summarization prompt with explicit quality evaluation
